title: tcgews: Predictive Tropical Cyclogenesis Using Machine Learning
description: Source code accompanying the dissertation "Predictive Tropical Cyclogenesis Using Machine Learning: A Novel Approach to Early Warning Systems" (Nikolay Todorov, Chapman University). A spatio-temporal ConvLSTM that predicts calibrated genesis-location probability fields for tropical cyclogenesis across 0-48 h lead times in two ocean basins (North Atlantic/Caribbean/Gulf and Western Pacific), trained under leave-one-year-out cross-validation and delivered through an operational early-warning demonstrator.
